analysis.reasonEn: Despite four consecutive days of decline after the previous buy signal (RSI exiting oversold + CCI extreme rebound), RSI is attempting to break out of oversold territory from 42.3 to 44.0 today. MACD histogram worsened to -0.3485 but the improvement from 0.4952 five days ago has slowed. With the 5-day low at $38.83 and 20-day low at $35.00, a Higher Low pattern is possible. Considering a stop loss at 1.0x ATR ($2.56), a target price with a risk/reward ratio of 1.5x or higher can be set.
